archetype: ARCHETYPE 2 (THE PERFORMANCE PRO) combined with Marine aesthetics

headings.rules: Use for all H1-H4 headings. Apply uppercase formatting and tight tracking (`tracking-tighter`). Maximum size `text-6xl`. Provides an athletic, highly visible structure.

body.rules: Use for all standard text, labels, and table data. Extremely legible geometric sans. Use relaxed line height (`leading-relaxed`).

monospace.rules: Use exclusively for boat sail numbers, race split times, chronometers, and scoring tables to ensure perfect tabular alignment.

primary.description: Oceanic Cobalt. Use for active states and primary headers.

accent.description: Safety Orange. CRITICAL for the Race Officer massive finish buttons and live alerts.

layouts.spectator_landing: Bento Grid layout (`md:grid-cols-8` or `12`). Asymmetric layout. Use wide gaps (`gap-8`). Organize results in clear 'folders' using nested Cards and Tabs.
layouts.race_officer_console: Mobile-first tactical layout. One-glance = one answer. Sticky top header for active race status. The bottom 40% of the screen MUST be massive thumb-zone buttons (e.g., `h-32` or `h-40`) for one-handed recording of boat finishes while on the water.
layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density Grid Mode B (`gap-4`). Use maximum screen real estate. Use cardless, dense HTML tables for series and fleet management.

visual_enhancers.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee` for the Live Race-Day Notifications banner. Style it as an 'Editorial Ribbon': Safety Orange background, White text, `tracking-wider`, `font-bold`.
visual_enhancers.buttons: The 'Finish' button for the Race Officer must be Neumorphic + Tactile: massive, highly saturated, with a 2px inner stroke, and a deep ambient shadow. On press: distinct scale down (`active:scale-95`).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80` or `bg-black/70`) for sticky headers and bottom action sheets so the race context is never fully obscured.

components.tabs: Shadcn UI Tabs (for Class > Series organization). Customize: `h-auto` and generous padding (`p-4` or `p-6` inside tab content).
components.select: Shadcn UI Select for boat pre-selection (DNC) and RRS Penalty dropdowns. Never use native `<select>`.
components.table: Shadcn UI Table or custom HTML table for Low Point scoring. Use alternating row colors for readability outdoors.
components.toast: Use `sonner` for all notifications (e.g., 'Provisional Results Published', 'Time Recorded').

motion.micro_interactions: All interactive elements must have `hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform duration-200`.
motion.lists: Use staggered Framer Motion entrances for the Provisional Results table rows.
motion.live_updates: Subtle pulse animation (`animate-pulse`) on live timing numbers or 'Provisional' badges to indicate live state.

hero_backgrounds.description: White sailboats racing on sea - Use for the main Spectator Landing Page Hero background with a dark `bg-black/40` overlay to ensure text contrast.
People riding on sailboat close-up - Use for the Summer Series or class category cards (Dragon, Sonata, Wayfarer).
White yacht on dock - Soft background for admin login or setup screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Hybrid Fullstack app accommodating 3 roles: Spectator (public view), Race Officer (action console), and Admin (data dashboard).

Use a Mobile-first layout heavily weighted towards the Race Officer view. The 'Record Finish Time' button MUST be exceptionally large (e.g., `h-32` or taking up 40% of the viewport width/height) to allow blind/one-handed tapping on a moving, wet boat.
Use Shadcn UI extensively for Select (RRS dropdowns), Tabs (Classes/Series logic), and Tables (Provisional/Final Results), but override the default aesthetics with the high-contrast Nautical theme.

Install and integrate `react-fast-marquee` at the top of the Spectator landing page to display live Race-Day Notifications (course, start times, special rules, life jackets). Hide it when results are published.
Ensure the time capture function grabs the frontend device time immediately upon button press for precise racing accuracy.
Provide simple PIN/passcode role-based login to separate Spectator from Race Officer from Admin.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header over images; ALWAYS use a crystal glass effect (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80` or `bg-black/60`).
Ensure text contrast meets outdoor visibility requirements (APCA/WCAG AA). Do not use low-contrast grays on grays.

accessibility.contrast: CRITICAL: The app is used outdoors by officials under direct sunlight. Text on buttons and tables must have a minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Avoid light gray text.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements. Race Officer action buttons must be at least 120px tall.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined Oswald + Manrope typography strictly to maintain the athletic, nautical performance feel.
Create depth through layered design elements. Use crisp 1px borders and distinct ambient shadows rather than muddy blurs.
Do not center-align the app container. Keep reading flow left-aligned for data-heavy views like scoring and results.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💭). Use SVGs or icons.
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (hover/active scale).
Use `sonner` for toast notifications instead of standard alerts.
